article.title: This UAE-backed Fatah dissident is allying with Hamas and pushing a proposal to change Palestinian politics
article.author: Qassam Muaddi
article.content: A UAE-sponsored plan by exiled Fatah dissident Muhammad Dahlan to “end Palestinian division” has quietly become the working platform for an unlikely electoral alliance with Hamas. Here is what this could mean for the future of Palestinian politics.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
